name: ProbabilityTheory.exists_isUniform
statement:
lemma exists_isUniform [MeasurableSpace S] [MeasurableSingletonClass S]
    (H : Finset S) (h : H.Nonempty) :
    ∃ (Ω : Type uS) (_ : MeasurableSpace Ω) (X : Ω → S) (μ : Measure Ω),
      IsProbabilityMeasure μ ∧ Measurable X ∧ IsUniform H X μ ∧ (∀ ω, X ω ∈ H) ∧ FiniteRange X

name: ProbabilityTheory.exists_isUniform_measureSpace
statement:
lemma exists_isUniform_measureSpace {S : Type uS} [MeasurableSpace S]
    [MeasurableSingletonClass S] (H : Finset S) (h : H.Nonempty) :
    ∃ (Ω : Type uS) (mΩ : MeasureSpace Ω) (U : Ω → S),
    IsProbabilityMeasure (ℙ : Measure Ω) ∧ Measurable U ∧ IsUniform H U ∧ (∀ ω : Ω, U ω ∈ H) ∧
      FiniteRange U

name: ProbabilityTheory.exists_isUniform_measureSpace'
statement:
lemma exists_isUniform_measureSpace' {S : Type uS} [MeasurableSpace S]
    [MeasurableSingletonClass S] (H : Set S) (hH : H.Finite) (h'H : H.Nonempty) :
    ∃ (Ω : Type uS) (mΩ : MeasureSpace Ω) (U : Ω → S),
    IsProbabilityMeasure (ℙ : Measure Ω) ∧ Measurable U ∧ IsUniform H U
      ∧ (∀ ω, U ω ∈ H) ∧ FiniteRange U

name: Real.sum_mul_log_div_eq_iff
statement:
lemma sum_mul_log_div_eq_iff {a b : ι → ℝ} (ha : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ a i) (hb : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ b i)
    (habs : ∀ i ∈ s, b i = 0 → a i = 0)
    (heq : ∑ i ∈ s, a i * log (a i / b i)
      = (∑ i ∈ s, a i) * log ((∑ i ∈ s, a i) / (∑ i ∈ s, b i))) :
    ∃ r, ∀ i ∈ s, a i = r * (b i)

    (heq : ∑ i ∈ s, a i * log (a i / b i) = (∑ i ∈ s, a i) * log ((∑ i ∈ s, a i) / ∑ i ∈ s, b i)) :
    ∃ r, ∀ i ∈ s, a i = r * (b i)

name: Submodule.exists_equiv_fst_sndModFst
statement:
theorem exists_equiv_fst_sndModFst (E : Submodule R (B × F)) :
    ∃ (B' : Submodule R B) (F' : Submodule R F) (f : E ≃ₗ[R] B' × F') (φ : B →ₗ[R] F),
    (∀ x, (f x).1.val = x.val.1 ∧ (f x).2.val = x.val.2 - φ x.val.1) ∧
    (∀ (x₁ : B') (x₂ : F'), (f.symm (x₁, x₂)).val = (x₁.val, x₂.val + φ x₁.val))

    [DiscreteMeasurableSpace V] [Countable V]

          .of_discrete))
